parsed.draft_response:
Thanks for the details—this is a legal/privacy review request that needs our privacy team’s input.

We’ve received that your legal team is asking for confirmation regarding: (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs may include customer identifiers, before enabling EU customer records.

To route this to the right privacy contact, could you please share:
1) Which DPA document(s) and/or specific sections/clauses your legal team is reviewing (or paste the questions they need answered)?
2) Which systems/products/records you plan to enable for EU customers.
3) For “support logs,” what log types or systems are in scope (e.g., support tickets, error logs, audit logs) and whether customer identifiers are expected to appear.
4) Any requested data retention periods/policy details the legal team wants confirmed.
5) If available, the privacy contact name/team you prefer we route to (otherwise we’ll route to our privacy/compliance group for handling).

Once we have the above, we’ll forward your request for human review with the appropriate privacy contact.
promised_actions: Forward the request for human review to the appropriate privacy/compliance contact after receiving the listed clarifications.
safety_notes: Do not confirm subprocessors, retention, or logging behavior in the customer-facing reply because the details and specific DPA clauses were not provided and require human review.
Avoid promising timelines/SLA or stating legal conclusions.
